assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent 3D-rendered potato character arm for a modular avatar. Image 1 is the edit target, the hand-on-hip arm; image 2 is the material/style reference body, not an object to include. Replace the arm with a SHORT, stubby, naturally bent potato arm, elbow extending to the viewer's right, hand turning inward/downward to rest flat on the right hip of an unseen round body. Match the reference body's rough russet peel exactly: dense irregular pores, tiny dimples, mottled warm golden-brown skin, tactile organic surface, subtle subsurface shading. Five believable short rounded digits, relaxed fingers together with natural knuckle folds; visible thumbnail edge if appropriate. Upper arm and forearm compact and proportionate, no human-length thin tube. Keep elbow roughly at the right edge and palm lower-left of elbow; shoulder end on upper-left. Soft broad light from upper-left and warm ambient fill, realistic self-shadow between fingers, no harsh outlined seam. Entire arm only, no body, face, clothes, jewelry, outline, label, cast shadow onto background or extra objects. Truly transparent background, clean antialiased alpha. Preserve all detail. Single isolated arm, centered with generous transparent margins.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent mouth overlay for a premium detailed 3D potato avatar. Create a small feminine closed-lip smile, softly asymmetric with one corner subtly lifted, warm and confident rather than cartoonishly exaggerated. Muted rose lip tint, slender natural upper lip with a delicate cupid bow, gently fuller lower lip, fine realistic lip texture and a restrained satin highlight. Soft upper-left studio light, warm ambient fill, tiny self-shadow in the mouth line. Front view, level, subtle volume close to the face surface. Mouth only, NO surrounding patch of skin, NO face, NO teeth, NO nose, NO chin, NO freckles, NO white border or sticker outline, NO drop shadow on background. Crisp detailed antialiased silhouette fading naturally only at lip corners. True transparent background. Centered horizontal mouth with generous transparent margins. This must fit on a humorous, tactile potato character, not a fashion photograph; charming and understated.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent hairstyle layer for a detailed 3D potato avatar. A beautifully detailed chestnut-brown side ponytail hairstyle, front view, sculpted to sit directly on a broad rounded potato-shaped crown rather than a human mannequin. Smooth naturally swept side part, fine individual strands, gentle flyaways, small understated warm red satin tie, ponytail cascading on the viewer's right in loose soft bends. Large clean transparent face opening, no fringe over the eyes. The left temple curls softly downward, opposite the ponytail. Rounded top silhouette with modest volume, realistic layered hair depth and soft upper-left studio lighting. Keep the face opening broad and oval, roughly 55% of the hairstyle's width; leave generous transparent space below. Charming and feminine without exaggerated proportions. HAIR ONLY on true transparent background. No person, face, scalp skin, ears, body, neck, clothing, mannequin, lettering, outline or shadow onto background. Rendered animation-film realism with fine material detail, not flat vector, not doll plastic.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated mouth expression overlay for a detailed 3D animated potato character, on a truly transparent background. A gentle sad closed-mouth FROWN: a shallow inverted U crease, corners slightly downturned. The mouth is sculpted INTO an implied surface, not plump lips pasted on top. Main feature is a fine deep warm-brown crease, with only a very narrow soft russet skin bevel and subtle upper-left light along the lower edge. Delicate micro-pores, restrained organic detail; minimal skin border fading smoothly to transparency. Absolutely no thick sausage lip, no large yellow rim, no sticker border, no large patch of skin, no head, no face, no nose, no chin, no eyebrows, no teeth, no tongue, no drop shadow on background. The shape should be wider than it is tall (about 5:1), simple and readable at avatar size, softly sad rather than grotesque. Front view. Center the mouth LARGE within the image, occupying roughly 65 percent of width, with generous transparent margins; render finely detailed edges. Premium tactile animation-film style, warm potato character, not human cosmetic lips.

Detailed premium 3D rendered acetate, crisp alpha. Keep exact square-frame design, change only the incorrect arms and obstructed lenses.
